issuer: the Intendencia de Río Negro, through its traffic office

licence.name: Permiso Único Nacional de Conducir (categoría A)

note: Read 2026-10-30. Ley 18.191 (Tránsito y Seguridad Vial, 2007, as IMPO publishes it in force), art. 26: the licence is issued by the competent traffic authority in each department and every authority recognises the national licence issued in any department. The Congreso de Intendentes' Texto Ordenado of the Permiso Único Nacional de Conducir (PUNC; plenary resolutions of 27/7/2017, 19/12/2019 and 28/7/2022, the file dated 2-2023, published 25/07/2022 on gub.uy), the standard the Intendencias apply: category A (cars and vans up to 9 passengers) from 18; a first permit is provisional, for at most 2 years; afterwards the renewal's maximum term for A falls with age, 10 years up to 55, 9 at 56 down to 1 at 80, and a doctor may set a shorter term. Written: the PUNC category A from 18 for 10 years (the maximum to 55, the term most adults hold after the provisional first 2 years; neither the provisional term nor the shorter terms after 55 is held by the form). Río Negro's traffic department page gives 18, a first licence for car or motorcycle of 2 years, and its value as 1.25 UR. The fee is given in Unidades Reajustables (UR, the index unit the national statistics institute revalues monthly), not pesos; the form takes a currency, so it is null.

sources.title: Ley 18.191, Ley de Tránsito y Seguridad Vial en el Territorio Nacional (IMPO)
sources.said: Todo conductor de un vehículo automotor debe ser titular de una licencia habilitante que le será expedida por la autoridad de tránsito competente en cada departamento. ... Todas las autoridades competentes reconocerán la licencia nacional de conducir expedida en cualquiera de los departamentos

sources.title: Congreso de Intendentes, Texto Ordenado del Permiso Único Nacional de Conducir (PUNC)
sources.said: Gobierno Departamental (en delante GD) a un individuo de acuerdo a la potestad que la Ley 18191 le confiere ... Hasta 55 10
